content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the old terraces and let Inti (the sun) warm the stones while the valley opens below."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sweeping views over the red-tiled roofs, with Inti (the sun) warm on your face."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A sweet little museum where the story of cacao ends in a very tasty way."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The living heart of Cusco, where colonial arches meet Andean sky and every corner begs for a photo."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Golden temple of Inti (the sun), its perfect Inca stonework still whispers beneath the convent walls."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A cathedral stuffed with Cusqueño paintings, silver, and a very famous Last Supper with a guinea pig."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Morena Peruvian Kitchen serves hearty Andean flavours with plenty of vegetarian love near the plaza."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The great Inca stones of Sacsayhuamán, fitted like a puzzle by hands that knew the mountains."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"San Pedro Market hums with colour, fruit, and the scent of fresh bread."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Chicha serves Andean flavours with a vegetarian touch, a fine pause after the market."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Museo Inka holds the quiet stories of empire in stone, cloth, and gold."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"San Blas climbs on cobbles past little workshops and blue doors, a good wander for the eyes."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"La Bodega 138 keeps it simple and warm, with honest vegetarian plates and a cosy corner."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the old terraces and watch Inti (the sun) warm the valley below."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Thousands of salt pans glinting on the hillside, a photographer's dream."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Giant circular terraces that feel like a green amphitheatre for the earth."}]}
Plaza, temple, Inca stones, market colours, the Sacred Valley, then sweet views goodbye — all under Inti (the sun), all done.
